I understand why you’d ask, but **being healthy doesn’t by itself waive Happy Tails’ published boarding requirement**: it calls for Bordetella vaccination within the previous 6–12 months, depending on the vaccine. The site doesn’t describe a health-based exception, so I can’t tell you Lola can skip it or that the resort would accept her without it. ([happytailspetresorttx.com](https://www.happytailspetresorttx.com/vaccination-requirements-policies?utm_source=openai))

Please ask your veterinarian whether a booster is appropriate for Lola, and ask Happy Tails directly whether they allow any exception. Boarding settings bring dogs into close contact, which is why many facilities require respiratory vaccines; vaccination also doesn’t eliminate all risk.
